CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — MOCK EXAM #13
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Game 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Analy with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

3. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple

6. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)

   C. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   D. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.

8. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   C. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.

9. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.
   C. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration.
   D. Practise Fabric Decoration with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the costume
   C. Only the volume
   D. The speed of the music

11. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)

13. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)

   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   D. Damage equipment used for Netball.

14. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.

15. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Analysis of Creative Arts and Sports and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
